protocol:
(review 35 item 4, verbatim in substance):
- quota: dense-1, lexical-1, dense-2, lexical-2 placed first; deduplicated by hit id, with no backfill of a quota; then every unseen hit
  in frozen RRF order;
- file: sum the frozen RRF scores once per unique hit per file; order files by that sum, ties by their best frozen rank, then path; emit
  each file's hits in frozen order, file and section records kept.
Protocol: exactly three fresh-container repetitions on the same 16 cases; retrieve once per case and capture the exact inputs production
fuse receives; score the frozen code and both variants on those inputs.
Adoption gate, for each variant against the frozen code, review 34's unchanged: its worst symbol-hits-at-5 count over the three repetitions
exceeds the frozen code's best; in every repetition it has no fewer file hits at 5, required evidence in context or required files in
context; mean irrelevant tokens at most 16,000. If both pass, the higher worst-case symbol count wins; a tie keeps the frozen code. An
incomplete repetition makes the result inconclusive. No further variant or extension after seeing results. A passing variant is not adopted
here: quota-first or file-first ordering changes plan v2's fusion contract (RRF, then utility and stable ties), so adoption needs a
complete approved successor first.
